items.title: From VDI to WorkSpaces for AI agents: What’s Next for Amazon WorkSpaces at re:Invent 2026
items.summary: AWS re:Invent 2026 is almost here, November 30 to December 4 in Las Vegas, and it’s shaping up to be a pivotal year for cloud desktops with Amazon WorkSpaces. Whether you are planning a large migration, exploring how AI agents can securely work alongside your people, or looking for simpler ways to provision and manage […]
